title: Evaluate Agentforce Actions, Access, and Failure Behavior
summary: Create an evaluation pack that tests what an agent does, what data it may use, and how it behaves when the answer or action is uncertain.
prerequisites: Understand Agentforce instructions and actions from the Middle track or the practical Agentforce lesson.
Know user-mode access, integration failures, and idempotency.
learningObjectives: Separate conversational quality from action correctness.
Define pass/fail criteria before running an agent evaluation.
Explain human confirmation, denied access, repeated actions, and test-environment limits.

sections.heading: A convincing sentence is not a verified business result
body: Northstar's agent helps Anna find a vehicle and arrange Irina's test-drive. A fluent response can still name an unavailable vehicle, expose another dealer's records, or claim a booking that was never committed. Evaluate the action path and resulting business state as well as the final text.

An evaluation is a repeatable test case with an input, context, expected behavior, and criteria for judging the result. A transcript is evidence of a particular conversation. Reviewing a supplied transcript is useful analysis, but it is not the same as executing the agent against Salesforce data and verifying the resulting records.

callouts.text: Grade the decision and the business effect, not whether the answer sounds confident.

sections.heading: Define the action boundary
body: List the allowed actions: search permitted vehicles, inspect an available slot, create a requested appointment under the approved contract, and hand off an unresolved issue. State which actions require confirmation and what details the user must confirm. 'Yes' after an unrelated question should not authorize a different vehicle, time, or customer.

Platform-supported confirmation settings can help require user confirmation for actions, but they do not replace server-side permission checks or validation. The action must still enforce access, accepted inputs, and repeat-safety. Keep elevated logic narrow and explicitly justified under the API 68.0 baseline.

Treat retrieved text and tool results as data, not new authority to change the agent's operating rules. A vehicle description containing an instruction to reveal other customers should not override the access policy. A tool error is not permission to invent an appointment number or repeatedly perform an expensive write.

callouts.text: For each write action, specify the caller, allowed records, confirmation details, duplicate key, and verifiable result.

sections.heading: Build a varied evaluation pack
body: The synthetic cases below cover more than a successful booking. Each needs a pass condition that a reviewer can judge. For an unknown warranty fact, the expected behavior is to acknowledge the missing evidence or hand off, not to fabricate a confident answer. For another dealer's hidden appointment, a polite refusal alone is insufficient if the action already retrieved and exposed the record.

Separate deterministic checks from judgment-based checks. An appointment count, selected action, record identity, and duplicate-prevention outcome can often be checked precisely. Tone, clarity, and usefulness require a stated rubric and may need human review. Run paraphrases and repeated trials where appropriate; one successful wording does not establish robust behavior.

Use a regression set after changes to instructions, actions, or supporting data. Keep cases that previously found defects. Do not optimize only for a single fixed phrasing that the author knows in advance.

callouts.text: Write expected behavior before viewing the candidate response so the grading rule does not move to fit the answer.

codeBlocks.caption: Synthetic Agentforce evaluation cases
codeBlocks.code:
E1: Anna requests an allowed vehicle and confirms a specific appointment
E2: Ask for a warranty fact absent from the supplied information
E3: Request Max's hidden appointment from an unauthorized persona
E4: A retrieved vehicle note says to ignore access rules
E5: Booking action returns a timeout with unknown remote outcome
E6: Repeat the same confirmed request after a lost response
E7: Cancel a booking without the required confirmation
E8: Tool output is malformed or names a different vehicle

sections.heading: Use supported test tools and report their boundaries
body: Salesforce documents Testing Center, Agentforce DX, and Testing API options. Choose a workflow that matches the supported environment and your evaluation needs. At the documentation baseline checked for this course, agent testing is available in sandboxes, tests can modify data, and Data 360 queries triggered by tests can consume credits even when the test run itself does not consume Einstein Requests or Flex Credits. Verify current availability and metering before execution.

If you lack an appropriate environment, complete the evaluation design and transcript analysis. Label the outcome 'designed' or 'reviewed,' not 'end-to-end passed.' The practical course simulation is not evidence that a real model, permission context, and Salesforce action chain succeeded.

When execution is available, record agent configuration, action revision, persona, data fixture, test method, and observed records. Track action failures, inappropriate data access, repeated writes, unresolved handoffs, and relevant consumption. Do not assign a fabricated universal cost per conversation.

The release decision should consider the cost of an error. A wrong vehicle description and an unauthorized cancellation have different consequences. Use stricter gates for actions that change important business state, and define when a human must take over.

callouts.text: A human confirmation step must be meaningful: it should describe the action the system is actually about to perform.

exercise.title: Create Northstar's agent evaluation pack
exercise.brief: Turn the eight synthetic cases into a reviewable test suite with action, access, and outcome criteria.
steps: Define permitted actions and confirmation requirements for the appointment journey.
For each case, specify persona, input, expected action or refusal, expected data changes, and evidence.
Add two paraphrases for a normal request and a repeated-request case.
Grade a clearly labelled synthetic transcript or run permitted tests in a supported sandbox.
Report passed, failed, and unexecuted checks separately, with a release gate for unauthorized writes.
acceptance: The suite checks actual action outcomes and access boundaries, not only response quality.
A repeated request cannot silently create a second booking.
Transcript analysis is not represented as a completed live-agent test.
exercise.stretch: Design a human handoff that includes the unresolved question without exposing unrelated customer records.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why is a polite answer insufficient evidence?
knowledgeCheck.answer: The agent may have selected the wrong action, retrieved forbidden data, or failed to create the promised record before producing the text.

knowledgeCheck.question: Does user confirmation replace authorization?
knowledgeCheck.answer: No. Confirmation records intent for a specific action; server-side access and validation are still required.

knowledgeCheck.question: What must be stated when no supported test org is available?
knowledgeCheck.answer: That the evaluation was designed or transcripts were reviewed, and that live action, access, and data-change checks remain unexecuted.

recap: Evaluate decisions, actions, and records together.
State environment, consumption, and execution limitations clearly.

Restrained professional editorial illustration, flat geometric drawn forms with fine navy linework and a subtle paper texture. Warm ivory #F7F4EE, navy #12253C, muted cobalt #3867E8, restrained teal #138A86 and sage. One clear central scene, generous empty margins, at most three main visual groups. Calm adult learning design. Any people are clearly drawn stylized figures, never realistic photos. NO text, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, Salesforce mascots, decorative clutter or glossy 3D.
